steps.title: Evidence ledger grows to 7 certified claims
steps.narration: The certified-claims ledger now shows seven rows. The newest entry certifies that the 3-month relative-strength factor's 60-day hold delivered a +21.34% out-of-sample edge over a controlled SPY benchmark, registered today.
steps.point_out: Count the rows on the ledger page — a 7th row has appeared at the bottom, titled 'rs_spy_3m — top decile (D10)' with the edge of +21.34% clearly visible.

steps.title: New evidence row: 3-month relative-strength, 60-day certified edge
steps.narration: The deep-link anchor scrolls the page directly to the new certified entry, which shows the full statistical record — the edge, the p-value, the registration date, and a link back to the Factor Lab that produced the claim.
steps.point_out: The 'rs_spy_3m — top decile (D10)' row is now in the viewport. Notice the edge of +21.34%, the p-value of 0.0005, the date 2026-07-01, and the 'Backs: Research factor lab →' link inside the row.

steps.title: Factor Lab: rs_spy_3m 60-day horizon is now Proven
steps.narration: On the Factor Lab, the 3-month relative-strength factor row now carries a distinct Proven badge on its 60-day column. The 1-day, 5-day, 10-day, and 20-day horizons all still read 'Not yet proven' — only what cleared the out-of-sample bar is certified.
steps.point_out: Find the 'Relative strength vs SPY (3m)' row in the factor table. The 60d cell shows a Proven pill in a distinct style, while the 1d, 5d, 10d, and 20d cells remain in the muted 'Not yet proven' state.

steps.title: Proven badge links directly to the matching evidence row
steps.narration: Clicking the Proven badge on the factor lab jumps straight to the matching entry in the Evidence ledger — the deep-link anchor scrolls the exact row into view without any manual searching.
steps.point_out: After the click, the URL ends with /evidence#factor-rs_spy_3m-d10-h60 and the page scrolls to the rs_spy_3m row — not the page top, and not a different factor's row.

steps.title: Evidence row links back to the Factor Lab — full round-trip
steps.narration: Every evidence row carries a Backs link that returns you to the research tool that generated the claim, closing the audit trail in both directions without any dead ends.
steps.point_out: After clicking 'Backs: Research factor lab →', the browser returns to /research/factor-lab — the complete round-trip from factor lab to proof and back is fully wired.

steps.title: Stock leaderboard unchanged — no new rs_spy_3m column
steps.narration: Certifying a factor's edge on the Evidence ledger does not automatically add a new score column to the stock leaderboard. The three existing columns stay exactly as they were — certifying an edge is separate from deciding to promote it to a scored signal.
steps.point_out: Scan the column headers: LEADERSHIP, ENTRY QUALITY, RISK — no rs_spy_3m or relative-strength column appears, and no stock row shows a new badge from this certification.
